issue.title: CSV exports open in a single column in German Excel
issue.body:
Our Vienna office runs Excel with Austrian settings. Double-clicking a CSV
export puts each whole line into column A, as
`Date,Amount,Currency,Description,Category`, because Excel there expects
semicolons between columns. XLSX opens fine, but the tool we load the files
into only takes CSV. Could the CSV export offer a semicolon as the separator,
as a choice next to the format?

input.title: Allow a semicolon separator for CSV exports
input.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

toDelimited() joins every field with a hard-coded "," and escapeField() quotes only on ",", quote or newline, so the CSV separator cannot be chosen. Add an optional delimiter parameter (default ",") to toDelimited and escapeField, quoting fields that contain the active delimiter. Then let writeCsv in src/export/csv.ts and the export endpoint in src/api/reports.ts accept a separator option (for example ?separator=semicolon) so Austrian/German Excel users can get ";"-separated files. Default output stays unchanged.
